Grants the following upon readying the weapon within ? seconds of scoring a kill with a different weapon:
• 0.75?x ADS Duration Multiplier
• ?% Decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness

Buff lasts 7 seconds. Kills while Discord is active refund ammo to the Magazine.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased.
)

Grants the following for #e${7+#d} seconds upon readying the weapon within 7? seconds of scoring a kill with a different weapon:
• 0.75?x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier
• 25% Decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness

Weapon Kills while Discord is active fully refill the Magazine of Primary Weapons, and refund 1 Ammo for Special Weapons.
